title: Parineeti Chopra Calls JOALI Maldives' Villas the Best After Motherhood Getaway
excerpt: The actor shared glimpses from her art-immersive island stay on Muravandhoo Island, praising the resort's design, personalised service and food while calling the trip perfect 'me time'.
body:
• Actor Parineeti Chopra shared photos and video from her stay at JOALI Maldives on Instagram on September 15, calling the resort's accommodation "the best villas in the Maldives" on a trip taken nearly a year into motherhood.
  • JOALI Maldives is an art-immersive luxury resort on Muravandhoo Island in Raa Atoll, with 73 villas ranging from one to four bedrooms, each with a private pool, plus a dedicated "Jadugar" assigned to personalise every guest's stay.
  • Chopra described slow mornings, barefoot beach walks, massages, time in the ocean and five dining venues as part of a getaway she called the perfect recipe for "me time".
  • Rates start at around US$2,376 (roughly ₹2 lakh) per villa per night on select advance-purchase, half-board offers, according to the resort's booking terms, with taxes additional and prices varying by villa category and dates.

Parineeti Chopra has given her followers a look inside JOALI Maldives, one of the country's most design-driven luxury resorts, after escaping there for what she described as much-needed "me time" nearly a year into motherhood. Sharing a carousel of pictures and a video from the trip on Instagram on September 15, the actor praised almost every aspect of the property in unusually effusive terms.

"I wanted to be drenched in luxury and spoilt silly. @joalimaldives did just that."

— Parineeti Chopra, on Instagram

Chopra called the resort's accommodation "the best villas in the Maldives" and described the island as "the most thoughtfully designed, gorgeous island," adding that the staff seemed to be at work just for her, according to her post reported by Hindustan Times.

An art-immersive island on Muravandhoo

JOALI Maldives is not a conventional beach resort. Located on Muravandhoo Island in the northern Maldives, the property positions itself as an art-immersive luxury island resort, with interiors created in collaboration with international artists and local artisans and Maldivian craftsmanship woven into its spaces. The island is surrounded by marine life, including corals, turtles and manta rays.

The resort has 73 villas, comprising private overwater and beach villas with pools. Guests can choose from one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom configurations, making the property suited to couples, families and larger groups. Third-party booking platforms currently list entry-level rates broadly between US$2,290 and US$2,936 per night, with MakeMyTrip showing a starting price of about ₹2.22 lakh per night, though rates swing with dates and villa category.

Personalised service and five dining venues

One of the resort's signature touches is the Jadugar — "magician" in the local language — a dedicated attendant assigned to each guest to personalise the stay. Chopra said the experience made her feel "like a queen — and a little girl."

Food was another highlight. The resort currently lists five dining options — Vandhoo, Saoke, Bellinis, TUH'U and Mura Bar — spanning multiple cuisines. In her vacation video, Chopra joked about adding "one vanilla scoop" to her itinerary, saying, "Ek ice cream everyday."

Slow mornings, beach walks and massages

Rather than a sightseeing-heavy itinerary, Chopra's trip was built around the slower side of island life: barefoot beach walks, soothing massages, swimming and long meals. "Slow mornings, lazy afternoons, beautiful sunsets," she wrote. She described herself as a "water baby," adding that the surrounding ocean mesmerised her, and summed up the break in Hindi: "Yeh trip mere liye thode me time ke liye ek perfect recipe thi" — this trip was the perfect recipe for some me time.

How much it costs

A stay at JOALI Maldives comes with a luxury price tag. According to Hindustan Times, rates start at around US$2,376 — roughly ₹2 lakh — per villa per night for select advance-purchase offers with half board. Prices vary by villa category, travel dates and availability, and taxes and charges are additional. The resort's official website carries current rates and bookings.

Why Indian travellers keep choosing the Maldives

Chopra's getaway reflects a familiar pattern: the Maldives remains one of the top international luxury picks for Indian travellers, thanks to short flight times, visa-friendly entry and a deep bench of resorts that court the Indian market. Celebrity endorsements — and the Instagram carousels that follow — continue to shape where diaspora and Indian travellers book their big holidays.
